_comment: Orc-front spike barricade (content pass C5, plan-content-zones12.md §4 + §10 hazard fixtures): environmental hazard shaping the boss approach — brazier pattern like the poison pool: collisionLayer 32 = Viewport ONLY (structurally unkillable, interaction-free body), collisionMask 16 = Border only (non-blocking). Hurts while stood in (physical+bleed), grants NOTHING (XP 0). Deliberately kept on the default hostile faction (no faction key): it wounds only players — orc-faction spikes would bleed the army line and tilt the unattended war. role structure — the aura is always-on and it authors no aggroRadius; speed 0 keeps it planted.
